verdicts.title: Generalizing Boolean Satisfiability II: Theory
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This is the second of three planned papers describing ZAP, a satisfiability engine that substantially generalizes existing tools while retaining the performance characteristics of modern high performance solvers. verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes ZAP, a SAT solver leveraging permutation group structure on literals to exploit problem symmetries — it does not discuss Frobenius indices, vector spaces spanned by clauses, or any size/complexity scaling law like Θ(Σ|C|^(1/k)).
